_readme: Stored ESTIMATE prices used when a live price cannot be fetched (and for providers with no live source). These are US reference list prices (pay-as-you-go, Linux, standard object storage, first-tier internet egress). They are NOT verified against provider price lists until 'last_manual_review' is filled in. After checking each source_url, put the date (YYYY-MM-DD) in 'last_manual_review' and set 'verified' to true for the entries you checked.
